**Orglet 0.2.2** — Windows build from `main` at [`bc67ccf`](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/commit/bc67ccfb03e65556590644a16d1ee9449a10ca27) after [#25](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/pull/25), [#26](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/pull/26), and [#24](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/pull/24).

The Windows installer is unsigned. SmartScreen may warn that Windows protected your PC. That is expected for 0.2.x. If you downloaded Setup from this GitHub Release, choose More info → Run anyway.

- License: [AGPL-3.0](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/blob/v0.2.2/LICENSE)
- Packaged platform: **Windows only** (macOS ZIP packaging exists for dogfood and is not a Release asset)
- Release gates: [docs/windows-release-gates.md](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/blob/v0.2.2/docs/windows-release-gates.md)

`v0.2.0` and `v0.2.1` are unchanged. `package.json` is `0.2.2`, so Setup/ZIP filenames match.

### Since v0.2.1

- Bound long-chat prompts with summary, retrieval, and refuse (COD-32, #25)
- Developer ID sign macOS CI; notarize still blocked (COD-20, #26)
- Hide the task pile — worker and team chats are the UX (COD-26, #24)

Installers are unsigned Setup.exe + ZIP from Windows CI `packaged` on this commit ([run 35384521236](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/actions/runs/35384521236)).

Human installer smoke was not run on a clean Windows machine. Windows CI packaged smokes were green on this tag.
